dispute_ticket.description: Two problems with this booking. First, the driver was stuck somewhere for ages so I cancelled, and I still got charged a $5 cancellation fee. Second, I used a $4 promo code on this booking and it's gone now. I want the fee back and my promo code back.

chat_logs.content: Hi, the app says you're still quite far?
Sorry, bad jam on the PIE slip road, moving very slowly.
It's been almost 20 min, I'm going to cancel and take the MRT.

app_events.details: Rider R-3358 booked trip RYDE-DEMO-019 with promo code SAVE4 (S$4.00 off). Driver ETA at booking: 7 minutes (18:17).
Rider cancelled 19 minutes after booking; driver still 2.1 km away, 12 minutes past the quoted ETA. S$5.00 cancellation fee charged.
Promo code SAVE4 automatically returned to rider R-3358's account (valid until 2026-10-31).

expected_outcome.reason: Two asks, decided separately. (1) The fee: GPS shows the driver still 2.1 km away at cancellation, 12 minutes past the quoted 7-minute ETA, beyond this trip's 10-minute delay threshold, so the S$5.00 cancellation fee should not have been charged and is refunded. (2) The promo code: the promo_recredited event shows SAVE4 was automatically returned at cancellation, as this trip's policy provides, so there is nothing to restore. Both asks end up satisfied (the fee by this ruling, the promo before it), so upheld with a S$5.00 refund; an ask already resolved before the ruling counts as satisfied (definition decided 2026-10-02, before the fix was evaluated).
